name: crux
description: A sidebar that shows the crux of your uncommitted changes: the core files and a one-line description of each major change, without tests, docs or mechanical edits.

autoSummarise.title: Summarise automatically
autoSummarise.description: After each turn that changed files, ask a small model to describe the core changes. Off: rules only, no model calls.

model.title: Summary model
model.description: The model that writes the change descriptions.

ignore.title: Also hide
ignore.description: Comma-separated globs of paths to hide, on top of tests, docs, lockfiles and build output. Example: src/generated/**, *.sql
